class.name: OcgPolyCoherenttriangle
class.brief_description: Data class used in Poly_CoherentTriangultion. Implements a triangle with references to its neighbours.
class.description: /** * Data class used in Poly_CoherentTriangultion. * Implements a triangle with references to its neighbours. */

method.name: Node
method.description: Query the node index in the position given by the parameter 'ind'

method.name: SetConnection_2
method.description: Create connection with another triangle theTri. This method creates both connections: in this triangle and in theTri. You do not need to call the same method on triangle theTr.

method.name: SetConnection_1
method.description: Create connection with another triangle theTri. This method creates both connections: in this triangle and in theTri. This method is slower than the previous one, because it makes analysis what sides of both triangles are connected.

method.name: RemoveConnection_1
method.description: Remove the connection with the given index.

method.name: RemoveConnection_2
method.description: Remove the connection with the given Triangle.

method.name: NConnections
method.description: Query the number of connected triangles.

method.name: GetConnectedNode
method.description: Query the connected node on the given side. Returns -1 if there is no connection on the specified side.

method.name: FindConnection
method.description: Returns the index of the connection with the given triangle, or -1 if not found.
